newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ortiz reiterates 5 to 6 pct Mexico Q1 GDP forecast.
newsitem.headline: Ortiz reiterates 5 to 6 pct Mexico Q1 GDP forecast.

text.p: Finance Minister Guillermo Ortiz reiterated on Tuesday the forecast that gross domestic product grew 5.0 to 6.0 percent in the first quarter.

"It's possible GDP growth during the first quarter will be between five to six percent, that is our estimate," Ortriz told reporters after speaking at a conference held by Mexico's foreign trade development bank, Bancomext.
He said industrial production in January and February as well as employment data up to March were the basis for the Finance Ministry's forecast.
Ortiz noted that the expectations for a strong GDP rise were for a quarter that included 10 percent fewer working days than the first quarter of 1996.
He noted that Easter week this year fell in March, whereas last year it occurred in April, meaning fewer working days in the first quarter this year.
